source_policy: Resolve and freeze SHA256 of whole cores, registered encoder and normalization artifacts before preflight; no source95 substitution.

train.selection: torch.randperm(70000, generator seeded 117+seed)[:4096]; map i<1000 to i, otherwise i+640; preserve this order
train.optimizer_start: fresh Adam, not historical optimizer continuation
train.old_loss: unchanged phase primary + 5 * positive-product actual-spike loss
train.encoder: frozen registered native encoder and fixed normalization

eval.readout: actual event * gate traces; unchanged production positive component-Pearson product, threshold 0.50, min group size 2, largest component background

promotion.comparisons: both matched control and initial SW0097
promotion.bootstrap: 10000 paired resamples, RNG seed113; draw the SAME image indices across all three seeds; mean seed-wise paired deltas; two-sided percentile 95% CI lower bound >0 against both references; conditional on these fixed seeds

integrity.labels: GT only for frozen endpoint scoring; never for training, mask construction, thresholds, preflight selection or coefficient tuning
integrity.mask_contract: no decoder mask, GT object count, gate-only final prediction, or alternate classifier
integrity.failures: Technical preflight failure stops this branch without parameter retuning; endpoint failure is retained and does not cancel unrelated experiments.
integrity.dependencies: own source/cache/implementation/preflight checks only; no SW108 or SW109 completion barrier

matched_control_reuse: Allowed only after SHA-verified identical source, train IDs/order, eligible legacy core parameters, old loss, optimizer, clipping, forward and core update identity. Otherwise run a fresh paired control. SW0097 initial metrics are a separate reference, never the 256-update matched control.
hypothesis: Assignment-only RGB credit can improve actual-spike grouping while preventing SW106 joint encoder/graph drift.

intervention.H: Exact production classification of detached actual q. One-hot background plus predicted FG groups, ragged K >=1; no cap or GT object count; singleton/discarded nodes obey production background policy.
intervention.content: F is native standardized/clipped 8-D gamma; z=(W.T @ F.detach()) / clamp(W.sum(nodes),min=1e-8)
intervention.decoder: shared MLP [pooled gamma8, patch XY2] ->64 ReLU->64 ReLU->3 sigmoid; no mask head or slot ID
intervention.target: mean RGB of each native 8x8 patch from the exact 128x128 preprocessing, [0,1]
intervention.reconstruction_loss: RGB MSE mean over 256 patches and 3 channels per image, then batch mean
intervention.core_losses: candidate old + lambda*reconstruction; control old only
intervention.decoder_loss: unweighted reconstruction in BOTH arms via separate gradients; do not multiply by lambda or accumulate decoder gradients twice

warmup.trainable: decoder only; source core/encoder/graph bitwise immutable
warmup.shared: both arms load exact same decoder weights AND decoder Adam state
warmup.forbidden: Do not reuse SW106 source95 decoder warmup or calibration.

calibration.data: first four ordered TRAIN batches after shared warmup
calibration.parameters: unique eligible core parameter union only, excluding encoder/legacy graph/decoder
calibration.guards: Both norms finite and strictly positive in every batch; no epsilon rescue or val-selected lambda.
calibration.sharing: One frozen seed0 lambda reused for all three seeds; no per-seed calibration.

preflight: Freeze encoder and every legacy graph parameter through warmup, calibration and pilot; detach content inside pool as an additional structural guard.
Actual q-to-W reconstruction gradients finite/nonzero at eligible core; K1, zero/one FG group and ragged batch shapes handled.

First four TRAIN batches after warmup: per-image deterministic row-permutation of H with seed 106+16*seed+16*batch+image_index, recompute pooling; mean shuffled reconstruction loss must exceed real loss. No GT and no warmup retuning.
Candidate/control same warmup checkpoint and Adam SHA; core fresh Adam starts after warmup.
Use autograd.grad separately: core receives old+lambda*rec (candidate) or old (control), decoder receives unweighted rec exactly once; clip each optimizer family separately.
Cache may reuse verified exact RGB bytes and ID mapping from SW106, but source95-derived model/warmup/calibration artifacts may not be reused.
Decoder never provides masks; native actual-spike classifier is the only endpoint.
budget: 32 shared decoder-only warmup steps per seed, then exactly 256 core and 256 decoder steps per arm; decoder optimizer resumes shared warm state.
